name: @swfte/mcp-server
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Swfte AI platform — build, validate, and deploy complete workflows, agents, chatflows, widgets, applications and MCP servers from Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP client.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
node -e "if(!process.env.SWFTE_PUBLISH_CONFIRMED){console.error('
[guard] @swfte/mcp-server is published only via the GitHub Actions release workflow.
        Set SWFTE_PUBLISH_CONFIRMED=1 to override.
');process.exit(1)}" && npm run verify:offline
scripts.smoke:protocol: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/protocol-smoke.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run preflight:mutation && npm run smoke:protocol && npm run probe:paths
scripts.verify:offline: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run preflight:mutation && npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/protocol-smoke.ts && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs
